name: TeamStarWolf - Sandworm operations ICS
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. The 49 ATT&CK for ICS techniques bound to dated Sandworm Team (G0034) events in case-studies/SANDWORM_OPERATIONS.md (2015, 2016 and 2022 grid attacks, NotPetya, Bad Rabbit, VPNFilter), each with a comment naming the source numbers. Scores indicate membership only.
